explee.wall: Walked past it by hand on 2026-09-28 (see __flow/). The hero form needs no account: submitting a website runs six live steps (company read, competitors, six campaigns with market sizes, real companies, real decision makers with emails, one written email) and ends on the only wall, email and card together on one screen (Stripe Payment Element, $30 credits, 'You won't be charged yet'). Creating an account (email + 6-digit code, no password) lands on an empty app that re-runs the same six steps and ends on the same card screen; nothing is saved to the account before the card.

revid.wall: Every signup CTA goes to /login: Google, or an email that gets a magic link ('Get started'), or 'Log in with password'. Behind it: the video creation workspace.

outrank.wall: Every signup CTA goes to /signin: Google, or an email that gets a sign-in link. Behind it: a 3-day trial and the keyword/article preview for the user's site.

trustmrr.wall: 'Add startup' opens a modal on the landing itself (payment provider + a read-only Stripe API key, then paid add-ons); submitting a key is the wall. 'Get API key' redirects to /login: Google or a 4-digit email code.

origami.wall: Walked by hand on 2026-09-28 (see __flow/). The hero asks for a domain (validated on the page), then after 600 ms sends to /sign-up?domain=...: first name, last name, email, then a Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' checkbox before the email code (or Google). The domain is not used before the account exists. The walk stopped at the captcha, which a person has to tick; behind it: their onboarding progress API (401 before an account exists) and the signal workspace.

oxygen.wall: Try for Free goes to a Clerk sign-up (first/last name, email, phone, password); the plan CTA (/subscribe?plan=oxygen_49) redirects to Clerk sign-in first. Clerk's widget refuses to render off its own domain (its API checks the Origin), so these two pages are SNAPSHOTS of what a browser rendered: faithful to look at, inert to click. Behind them: checkout for the chosen plan.

graphed.wall: Both CTAs ('Book demo', 'Book a discovery call') go to /register?returnTo=/book-demo: name, email, password or Google. Behind it: the demo booking page.

gojiberry.wall: Walked past it by hand on 2026-09-28 (see __flow/). Every CTA goes to app.gojiberry.ai/registration: first name, last name, business email, password, or Google. Right after, a pricing page, then Stripe Checkout: card required for the 7-day trial ($0 today, $99/month after). Until a card is on file every app route redirects to /pricing, and the website typed on the landing is never used.

keel.wall: There is no wall: Keel is a public demo workspace with no sign-up and no account, so every screen is reachable signed out. The whole app is mock data (the Loomwell workspace, 24 companies, 34 people, 38 deals, five agents) rendered in the browser, so the clone is the app, not a landing in front of it.
